name: Social Catfish
instructions: Search socialcatfish.com and note the address of every page that shows you. Open socialcatfish.com/opt-out, scroll to the section for removing pages, emails, phone numbers and addresses, and ask only for things it already shows. Give {contact_email} as your email; Social Catfish emails a confirmation link that OpenOptOut clicks for you. Then press "I've done this".
source: Process per BADBOOL's Social Catfish entry (only ask to remove what's listed; emailed confirmation link).
